let x: string | undefined = "a";
class K0 { static { console.log(x.length); } }
const K1 = class { static { console.log(x.length); } };
class K2 { static n = 1; static { K2.n = x.length + 1; } }
function f(p: string | undefined) {
  if (!p) return 0;
  class A { static n = 0; static { A.n = p.length; let q = 1; var r = 2; console.log(q + r, this.n); } }
  return A.n;
}
let s: string | number = "x";
class B { static { s = 1; } }
const k: number = s;
class C { static v: number; static { C.v = 3; const g = () => C.v; console.log(g()); } }
console.log(f("ab"), k, B, C.v, K0, K1, K2.n);
